label: A single coordinate update
subgoals: Set the partial derivative in the chosen variable to zero

label: A full sweep is Gauss-Seidel
subgoals: Update the first coordinate from the others' current values

Use the newest neighbour positions within the sweep
Repeat sweeps and watch information move one cell per sweep
